subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI sidebar permanently hides sessions after the first Gateway page

question: Should this protected Control UI pagination regression be assigned for a focused sidebar/Gateway repair now?
rationale: The supplied report is concrete, but the `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner decision before automated repair work is queued.

options.title: Sponsor focused repair
options.body: Assign an owner to verify the reported page-continuation gap and land a bounded controller-plus-regression-test fix.

options.title: Request current-main confirmation
options.body: Ask for a current-main reproduction trace if maintainers want to confirm the affected filters and page sizes before implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused repair
recommendation.body: Assign an owner to verify the reported page-continuation gap and land a bounded controller-plus-regression-test fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The report contains the only available source-level trace and reproduction definition; current history could not establish a more authoritative code owner.
